CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 04 / 12

Production and cost curves

Marginal product邊際產量

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate marginal product MP = Δoutput / Δinput from a production table; recognize increasing and diminishing marginal product and explain the shape of the production function.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

邊際產量為產量變化除投入變化。分工可能先提高 MP，但工人共享固定設備後 MP 可遞減；生產函數隨之變平。

MP is the change in output divided by the change in an input. It can initially rise with specialization and later fall as workers share fixed equipment. A production function becomes flatter when marginal product diminishes.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Output with 0,1,2,3 workers is 0,10,25,35. MPs are 10,15,10: first rising, then diminishing.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Output rises from 30 to 42 when labor rises from 3 to 4. MP? 邊際產量多少？
